column1: # Where AI coding agents keep their session transcripts. One line each, tab separated.
#   os      all, mac, linux or win (win is Git Bash and gird-check.ps1)
#   kind    read, or sealed for sessions stored encrypted (named as not checked)
#   path    a file or a folder. ~ is the home folder, {AS} the app data folder (Application Support
#           on a Mac, ~/.config on Linux, %APPDATA% on Windows), {LOCALAPPDATA}, {XDG_DATA}
#   source  how the location was established: measured, source code, docs or third party
